source.title: Written in Trade Today
source.summary: Series finale: five Arabic words, five centuries, five lessons for the trade wars of 2025.
source.author: Islamic Economics
source.body_text: In this series finale, we return to the present moment. As tariff walls rise and supply chains fragment, what would a medieval Karimi merchant say about the trade wars of 2025? Five words. Five lessons: transparency works, credit needs trust, maritime freedom benefits all, infrastructure is a public good, and risk should be shared. The principles hidden in our vocabulary are whispering. Are we listening?
